exposure: women carrying the KMO rs1053230 AG genotype
women carrying the KMO rs1053230 GG genotype
cohort: 710 Chinese women who underwent a cesarean section
finding: Heightened KMO activity, including that arising from KMO rs1053230 G/A genetic variations, is indicated as one possible mechanism driving the biological underpinnings of postpartum depressive symptoms after cesarean section.
